notes: Conspicuous Snoop's 'You may cast Goblin spells from the top of your library' is a static ability: its permission exists only while Snoop is on the battlefield (CR 604.2, 611.3a). With Snoop out, the Goblin on top is cast from the library for its {R}; once Snoop is gone the next Goblin on top is not offered. Contrast chandra_flame_s_catalyst_branch02: a permission a resolved ability made outlives its source (CR 611.2a). On the base the permission was a free activation, never a cast row.
